entries.name: Incline Push-Up
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on Family 25 rigid-body chain (the body line 64.62, spine 26.68, thigh and shin 18.97 exact) with the hands on the drawn platform top at y 55. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of an incline push-up on a raised platf

frames.caption: Start tall with the hands on the platform and the body in one line.
Lower the chest toward the platform with the elbows under control.
Take the chest to the platform through the range you own.
Hold the bottom without the hips sagging.
Press back to the start with the body braced.
